title: Fixed pattern shards for the Distribution suite

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-381#fixed-pattern-shards-for-the-distribution-suite (plan 654), revision cd35d3fe7923ee10716649b6a3653e761550045f

Promise: "CI runs every Distribution check exactly once across the fixed shares", scope clause "The last entry names no pattern and runs every discovered check that no earlier share claims". Expected observable behavior: share n/n returns only the discovered labels that no pattern share claims, so the shares partition the discovered checks.

Verdict: Caught.
Three maintained assertions failed on the independently observed wrong path:
1. Distribution/tests/support/test-share-matrix.test.mjs, test "the last share runs every check no earlier share claims, a new folder included" (line 74, deepEqual at line 77): share 3/3 returned evaluation/judge.sh, scripts/ci-proof.sh, skills/plan/deep/a.test.mjs and skills/plan/run.sh in addition to the three expected unclaimed labels.
2. Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-split.sh, expect_share third 3/3 (line 129): "third.record names [judge.sh plan.sh other.sh check-self-installation.sh], not [other.sh check-self-installation.sh]" — the runner actually ran the claimed checks in the last share.
3. Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-selection.sh, the node block at line 135 (expectCount over the concatenated 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 listings of the repository's real ci.yml): "occurrences of shell Distribution/evaluation/tests/git-publication/git-publication-native-one-shot-results.sh in the split listing 2 !== 1" — the exactly-once property against the real matrix.
Claim limited to the observed path: the last share additionally returning labels claimed by pattern shares. The alternative suggested fault (a pattern share dropping one claimed label) was not probed.

Next proof action: none required for this promise on this path; the existing proof stands.

Fault: scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs, selectShare final filter changed from
  share === undefined || owner(label) === share
to
  share === undefined || owner(label) === share || share === shares.at(-1)
(the last share also takes every label, in addition to each label's pattern owner). Suggested fault kept as given; validated against the revision's code. Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Checkout: scratch detached worktree at the selected revision (/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/bc68a321/tmp/ic), node_modules symlinked to the story worktree's for the run; pre-probe state clean against HEAD apart from that untracked symlink. Removed afterwards.

Command (all three runs): PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES=<file> bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-split.sh Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-selection.sh Distribution/tests/support/test-share-matrix.test.mjs (the times file was added only to prove which checks ran; it does not change selection).

Observations:
- Baseline: exit 0; times file listed all three checks (split 2.8 s, selection 1.5 s, share-matrix 0.7 s); node --test of the share-matrix file alone reported 13 tests, 13 pass.
- Independent wrong-behavior witness (separate from the maintained checks): the faulted selector run against the revision's real .github/workflows/ci.yml (share: [1, 2, 3]) with labels Distribution/tests/skills/dough-execute-plan/x.sh, Distribution/evaluation/y.sh, Distribution/tests/other/z.sh returned x.sh for 1/3, y.sh for 2/3, and all three labels for 3/3, so x.sh and y.sh would run twice across the CI shares.
- Faulted run: exit 1; all three checks reported FAIL, with the assertions listed above.
- Restoration: git checkout of the file; git diff --quiet HEAD clean; only the untracked node_modules symlink remained (as before the probe). The same command then exited 0 with all three checks in the times file (2.5 s, 1.4 s, 0.6 s). Scratch worktree removed; git worktree list no longer shows it.

Prior disposition: none recognized; this probe made no repair decision.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, wall-clock seconds from test.sh times files): baseline about 5.0 s summed per check (about 3 s elapsed with parallel jobs), faulted about 2.8 s summed, restored about 4.5 s summed.
- Human effort: unavailable; no separately supported measure (no human interaction during the probe).
- Agent effort: unavailable; no separately supported token or time measure is available to this agent.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 60979 ms (measured), from 1794798168000 to 1794798228979 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: cd35d3fe7923ee10716649b6a3653e761550045f, Caught, no follow-up.
